```{r TESTING: pull percentile bins and compare MAFs across - Partially authored by CLAUDE sonnet 5 medium}
compare_maf_by_shap_threshold <- function(df, 
                                            pct_cutoff = 0.80, 
                                            shap_col = "delta_shap", 
                                            maf_col = "MAF", 
                                            group_col = "group") {
  
  # --- Input checks ---
  required_cols <- c(shap_col, maf_col, group_col)
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(df))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop("Missing columns in df: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
  }
  if (pct_cutoff < 0 || pct_cutoff >= 1) {
    stop("pct_cutoff must be in [0, 1)")
  }
  
  groups <- unique(df[[group_col]])
  if (length(groups) != 2) {
    stop("group_col must have exactly 2 levels, found: ", 
         paste(groups, collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  # --- Threshold on |delta SHAP| ---
  abs_shap <- abs(df[[shap_col]])
  cutoff_value <- quantile(abs_shap, probs = pct_cutoff, na.rm = TRUE)
  df_filtered <- df[abs_shap >= cutoff_value & !is.na(abs_shap), ]
  
  n_total <- nrow(df)
  n_kept <- nrow(df_filtered)
  
  # --- Summary stats per group (on filtered subset) ---
  summary_stats <- do.call(rbind, lapply(groups, function(g) {
    maf_vals <- df_filtered[[maf_col]][df_filtered[[group_col]] == g]
    tibble(
      group   = g,
      n       = length(maf_vals),
      allpts = list(maf_vals),
      mean    = mean(maf_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
      median  = median(maf_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd      = sd(maf_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
      q25     = quantile(maf_vals, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      q75     = quantile(maf_vals, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }))
  rownames(summary_stats) <- NULL
  
  # --- Wilcoxon rank-sum test ---
  maf_g1 <- df_filtered[[maf_col]][df_filtered[[group_col]] == groups[1]]
  maf_g2 <- df_filtered[[maf_col]][df_filtered[[group_col]] == groups[2]]
  
  test_result <- wilcox.test(maf_g1, maf_g2, exact = FALSE, conf.int = TRUE,)
  
  # Rank-biserial correlation as effect size #I don't think this is an accurate or meaningful effect size - different effect size implemented later 
  n1 <- length(maf_g1); n2 <- length(maf_g2)
  U <- test_result$statistic
  effect_size <- 1 - (2 * U) / (n1 * n2)
  
  # --- Output ---
  list(
    pct_cutoff       = pct_cutoff,
    shap_cutoff_value = as.numeric(cutoff_value),
    n_total          = n_total,
    n_kept           = n_kept,
    frac_kept        = n_kept / n_total,
    summary_stats    = summary_stats,
    wilcox_test      = test_result,
    effect_size_rank_biserial = as.numeric(effect_size)
  )
}

#Appears to work 
compare_maf_by_shap_threshold(df=SHAP_max_delta_expr,group_col = "SHAP_EXP_DIR",shap_col="SHAP_Delta")

percentiles <- seq(.8, 0.99, by = 0.03)

MAF_comp_results <- lapply(percentiles, function(p) {
  r <- compare_maf_by_shap_threshold(SHAP_max_delta_expr, pct_cutoff = p,,group_col = "SHAP_EXP_DIR",shap_col="SHAP_Delta")
  tibble(pct_cutoff = p, 
             n_kept = r$n_kept,
             mean_MAF_oppose=r$summary_stats$mean[r$summary_stats$group=="oppose"],
            mean_MAF_support=r$summary_stats$mean[r$summary_stats$group=="support"],
         allpts_MAF_oppose=r$summary_stats$allpts[r$summary_stats$group=="oppose"],
                  allpts_MAF_support=r$summary_stats$allpts[r$summary_stats$group=="support"],
             group_balance=r$summary_stats[1,2]/sum(r$summary_stats[,2]),
             p_value = r$wilcox_test$p.value, 
             effect_size = r$effect_size_rank_biserial
              )
})

MAF_Comp_df <- do.call(bind_rows, MAF_comp_results)
```

```{r try for Mann Whitney U Tests across groups and annotated graph - partially authored with Claude Sonnet 5 - medium}
#install.packages("multcompView")
library(multcompView)
#install.packages("effectsize")
library(effectsize)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Assumes df has columns: MAF, group (support/oppose/Shuffled), cutoff (0.8...0.99)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
#let's look at it real quick if we remove 0.99 - which mostly just made the chart crowded and the intervals uneven. 

ShapExpShufSet_full2<-ShapExpShufSet_full%>% filter(cutoff!=0.99)
ShapExpShufSet_full2$group  <- factor(ShapExpShufSet_full2$category,  levels = c("support", "oppose", "Shuffled"))
ShapExpShufSet_full2$cutoff <- factor(ShapExpShufSet_full2$cutoff, levels = c(0.8, 0.85, 0.9, 0.95))
                                                                             #,0.99))

# Combine group + cutoff into one factor so every box is its own unit
ShapExpShufSet_full2$unit <- interaction(ShapExpShufSet_full2$group, ShapExpShufSet_full2$cutoff, sep = "_", drop = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. All pairwise Mann-Whitney tests across every box, Bonferroni-corrected
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
units <- levels(ShapExpShufSet_full2$unit)
pair_idx <- combn(units, 2, simplify = FALSE)

pw_results <- lapply(pair_idx, function(pr) {
  x <- ShapExpShufSet_full2$MAF[ShapExpShufSet_full2$unit == pr[1]]
  y <- ShapExpShufSet_full2$MAF[ShapExpShufSet_full2$unit == pr[2]]
  test <- wilcox.test(x, y, exact = FALSE)
  data.frame(group1 = pr[1], group2 = pr[2], p.raw = test$p.value)
})
pw_results <- bind_rows(pw_results)
pw_results$p.adj <- p.adjust(pw_results$p.raw, method = "bonferroni")

effsize_resutls<-lapply(pair_idx, function(pr) {
  x <- ShapExpShufSet_full2$MAF[ShapExpShufSet_full2$unit == pr[1]]
  y <- ShapExpShufSet_full2$MAF[ShapExpShufSet_full2$unit == pr[2]]
  test <- rank_biserial(x, y, exact = FALSE)
  data.frame(group1 = pr[1], group2 = pr[2], rbs= test$r_rank_biserial)
})
effsize_resutls <- bind_rows(effsize_resutls)
pAdjAndEFFs_res<-merge(x = pw_results, y=effsize_resutls,by=c("group1",
                                                              "group2"))
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Compact letter display (CLD) from the full p-value matrix
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
pmat <- matrix(1, nrow = length(units), ncol = length(units),
                dimnames = list(units, units))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(pw_results))) {
  g1 <- pw_results$group1[i]; g2 <- pw_results$group2[i]
  pmat[g1, g2] <- pw_results$p.adj[i]
  pmat[g2, g1] <- pw_results$p.adj[i]
}
diag(pmat) <- 1

cld <- multcompLetters(pmat, threshold = 0.01)$Letters
cld_df <- data.frame(unit = names(cld), letter = cld, row.names = NULL)

# split unit back into group/cutoff
cld_df <- cld_df %>%
  separate(unit, into = c("group", "cutoff"), sep = "_") %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = levels(ShapExpShufSet_full2$group)),
         cutoff = factor(cutoff, levels = levels(ShapExpShufSet_full2$cutoff)))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Asterisks: each real group vs. Shuffled at the SAME cutoff
#    (pulled straight out of pw_results using the adjusted p-values)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
sig_stars <- function(p) {
  cut(p, breaks = c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf),
      labels = c("***", "**", "*", "ns"))
}

vs_shuffled <- lapply(levels(ShapExpShufSet_full2$cutoff), function(cf) {
  ref <- paste0("Shuffled_", cf)
  lapply(c("support", "oppose"), function(g) {
    unit_g <- paste0(g, "_", cf)
    row <- pw_results[(pw_results$group1 == unit_g & pw_results$group2 == ref) |
                       (pw_results$group1 == ref & pw_results$group2 == unit_g), ]
    data.frame(group = g, cutoff = cf, p.adj = row$p.adj, stars = as.character(sig_stars(row$p.adj)))
  }) %>% bind_rows()
}) %>% bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = levels(ShapExpShufSet_full2$group)),
         cutoff = factor(cutoff, levels = levels(ShapExpShufSet_full2$cutoff)))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Compute y-position and x-position (dodge offset) for annotations
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
ymax_df <- ShapExpShufSet_full2 %>%
  group_by(group, cutoff) %>%
  summarise(ytop = max(MAF, na.rm = TRUE), median=median(MAF), .groups = "drop")

n_cutoff <- nlevels(ShapExpShufSet_full2$cutoff)
dodge_width <- 0.75
offsets <- seq(-(dodge_width - dodge_width/n_cutoff)/2,
                (dodge_width - dodge_width/n_cutoff)/2,
                length.out = n_cutoff)
offset_df <- data.frame(cutoff = levels(ShapExpShufSet_full2$cutoff), x_offset = offsets)

ann_df <- ymax_df %>%
  left_join(cld_df, by = c("group", "cutoff")) %>%
  left_join(vs_shuffled %>% select(group, cutoff, stars), by = c("group", "cutoff")) %>%
  left_join(offset_df, by = "cutoff") %>%
  mutate(x_pos = as.numeric(group) + x_offset,
         label = ifelse(is.na(stars) | stars == "ns", letter, paste0(letter, "\n", stars)))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
StatBoxPLot_ShapTiter<-ggplot(ShapExpShufSet_full2, aes(x = group, y = MAF, fill = cutoff)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width), outlier.shape = NA,alpha=0.7) +
  geom_text(data = ann_df,
            aes(x = x_pos, y = ytop * 1.4, label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3, lineheight = 0.8) +
  #geom_point(data = ann_df, aes(x = x_pos,y=median))+
  scale_y_continuous(transform = "log2",breaks=c(0,0.0005,0.001,0.005,0.01,0.05,0.1,0.5),labels=label_number(decimal.mark = "."))+
theme_classic()+
scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Supporting","Opposing","Shuffled"))+
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D",begin=0.7,end=.03,name = expression(paste("Percentile ","|",Delta,"SHAP|")))+
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank(),legend.position="bottom")

StatBoxPLot_ShapTiter
ggsave(StatBoxPLot_ShapTiter,filename="Boxplot_MannU_v01.png",units = "mm",width=170,height = 130)



```

```{r let's figure out how susceptible our conclusion is to different binning values}
#For 6 different bin numbers from 10 to 10000 (+ no binning) lets see what kind of variation we get in our results

bin_counts=c(10,50,100,200,1000,10000)
binplots<-vector('list',length(bin_counts))
for(i in 1:length(bin_counts)){
  bin=bin_counts[i]
  tmp_SHAP_max_delta_binned_cross<-SHAP_max_delta %>% group_by(SHAP_Signs_Cross) %>%  mutate(bin = ntile(SHAP_Abs_Delta, n=bin)) %>% group_by(SHAP_Signs_Cross,bin) %>% summarise(mean_MAF=mean(MAF),mean_adSHAP=mean(SHAP_Abs_Delta),mean_dSHAP=mean(SHAP_Delta))
                                                                                                                                                                                        
  binplots[[i]]<-ggscatter(data = tmp_SHAP_max_delta_binned_cross, x="mean_dSHAP",y="mean_MAF",  add = "reg.line",add.params = list(color = "red"),alpha=0.3)+
  ylim(0,0.6)+
  facet_wrap(~SHAP_Signs_Cross)+
  stat_cor(label.y=0.6)+
   stat_regline_equation(
    aes(label = paste(..eq.label.., ..adj.rr.label.., sep = "~~~~")))+
    ggtitle(bin)
  
}
binplots
```

```{r bin test to match manuscript draft}

bin_counts=c(10,50,100,200,500,1000,10000,50000)
binplots2<-vector('list',length(bin_counts))
for(i in 1:length(bin_counts)){
  bin=bin_counts[i]
  tmp_SHAP_max_delta_binned_manu<-SHAP_max_delta %>% mutate(Major_Pos=sign(SHAP_Major)>0) %>% group_by(Major_Pos) %>%  mutate(bin = ntile(SHAP_Abs_Delta, n=bin)) %>% group_by(Major_Pos,bin) %>% summarise(mean_MAF=mean(MAF),mean_adSHAP=mean(SHAP_Abs_Delta),mean_dSHAP=mean(SHAP_Delta))
                                                                                                                                                                                        
  binplots2[[i]]<-ggscatter(data = tmp_SHAP_max_delta_binned_manu, x="mean_dSHAP",y="mean_MAF",  add = "reg.line",add.params = list(color = "red"),alpha=0.3)+
  ylim(0,0.6)+
  facet_wrap(~Major_Pos)+
  stat_cor(label.y=0.6)+
   stat_regline_equation(
    aes(label = paste(..eq.label.., ..adj.rr.label.., sep = "~~~~")))+
    ggtitle(bin)
  
}
```
